name: Foundational Definitions
description: Foundational definitions extracted from Distributed Systems Principles Textbook establishing baseline terminology for distributed systems.
learning_objectives: Define core terminology associated with distributed systems
Identify fundamental components of a distributed architecture
common_pitfalls: Confusing distributed system definitions with centralized computing models

name: System Invariants
description: System invariants extracted from Distributed Systems Principles Textbook detailing persistent properties that must remain true across a distributed environment.
learning_objectives: Recognize critical system invariants in distributed executions
Explain the role of invariants in maintaining system correctness
common_pitfalls: Assuming local invariants automatically guarantee global system invariants

name: Structural Properties
description: Structural properties extracted from Distributed Systems Principles Textbook outlining the architectural organization and topology characteristics of distributed systems.
learning_objectives: Analyze the structural properties of distributed system topologies
Differentiate between various structural configurations in cloud computing
common_pitfalls: Overlooking network topology constraints when analyzing structural properties
